project_name: Bloco do Beco - Mapeamento Cultural do Jardim Ibirapuera

persona_and_concept.identity: E1 Anti-AI Design: Vibrant Brazilian Community Artistry + Swiss Typography Clarity + Tactical Street Culture Cartography
persona_and_concept.cultural_context: Bloco do Beco is a legendary grassroots cultural collective in Jardim Ibirapuera (Zona Sul de São Paulo, Brazil). The design blends warm terracotta, sun yellow, rich açai violet, vibrant leaf green, and deep obsidian with crisp editorial layout and accessible community metrics.
persona_and_concept.emotional_tone: Warm, celebrating community pride, creative vitality, empowering local artists and craftspeople (músicos, costureiras, artesãos, grafiteiros, dançarinos), highly functional, community-driven.

entry_surfaces./: split hero — brand banner + interactive stats snapshot left, real-time interactive Jardim Ibirapuera talent map preview right
entry_surfaces./talentos: editorial directory grid — search + multi-category filter bar top, profile cards bento grid below
entry_surfaces./talento/:id: immersive artist dossier — hero with gallery + bio left, activities/contact/map geoloc card right
entry_surfaces./atividades: community connection hub — filterable list of workshops, courses, and artistic services in Jardim Ibirapuera
entry_surfaces./mapa: full-canvas tactical map of Jardim Ibirapuera with interactive category pins, search box and artist summary drawer
entry_surfaces./painel-dados: high-density analytics command center — metric summary cards, recharts category breakdowns, gender, age, years of experience
entry_surfaces./cadastrar: branded talent registration flow — multi-step form with photo upload, coordinates/address geocoding, activities list
entry_surfaces./admin: password-protected management portal — quick stat counts, search & filter artist table with edit/delete modals

component_hierarchy.purpose: Hero impressionante do Bloco do Beco + Métricas de Impacto + Mapa Rápido + Destaques de Talentos e Atividades
Catálogo completo com busca em tempo real, filtros por categoria, tags de habilidades, ordenação e cards bento ricos
Perfil detalhado do artista com foto, biografia, galeria de trabalhos, lista de atividades no bairro, endereço no mapa e contato WhatsApp/Instagram
Mural de conexões comunitárias: oficinas, aulas de costura, rodas de samba, aulas de cerâmica e serviços sob encomenda
Mapa em tela cheia do Jardim Ibirapuera com pins coloridos por segmento, filtro interativo e drawer de detalhes do talento
Painel de métricas e indicadores culturais com gráficos Recharts acessíveis, filtros e opção de exportação dos dados
Formulário amigável de auto-cadastro para artistas do bairro, upload de imagem, preenchimento de endereço e cadastro de atividades
Painel administrativo protegido por senha com gestão de talentos cadastrados (aprovar, editar, excluir, exportar dados)

accessibility_and_motion.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA 4.5:1 on all text surfaces
accessibility_and_motion.motion_scale: Subtle stagger for cards (0.05s step), smooth hover lift (-2px with crisp box-shadow), modal ease-out 180ms
accessibility_and_motion.reduced_motion: Wrap animations with prefers-reduced-motion media query
accessibility_and_motion.keyboard_nav: Full tab indices on custom map popups, search filters and modal forms

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'leaflet' and '@types/leaflet' in frontend via `yarn add leaflet @types/leaflet` before rendering the map component.
Import Leaflet CSS in main or component: `import 'leaflet/dist/leaflet.css';`
Fix standard Leaflet default icon URL paths if needed or use custom SVGs with Lucide icons for category-colored pins.
Ensure all data charts in `/painel-dados` use Recharts with colors matching the theme palette (#E65100, #0D9488, #D97706, #7C3AED, #E11D48, #0284C7).

Pre-populate MongoDB with at least 10 high-quality seed talents in Jardim Ibirapuera (SP) with realistic addresses (e.g. Rua Inácio Dias, Rua Teresa Carreño, Av. Guido Caloi, Rua José Manoel Camisa Nova, etc.) and complete coordinates.
Include activities for talents so the 'Atividades no Bairro' tab is richly populated with active community workshops, sewing classes, pottery courses and samba rehearsals.
Implement the public registration flow with instant feedback via Sonner toast and auto-geocoding (or coordinate assignment based on street name) in Jardim Ibirapuera.
Implement the admin portal with a clean password modal or simple auth token so administrators of Bloco do Beco can moderate entries.
Ensure all buttons, inputs, links, filters, map controls, and stats cards include role-based `data-testid` attributes.
